ideas.pitch: A GitHub app that flags malicious or backdoor code changes in pull requests using an automated agent swarm, themed around finding the imposter in your codebase.
ideas.title: AmongUs-Sec: Zero-Trust Code Review & PR Tampering Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leans into the hackathon's Among Us theme with a functional security tool that judges can test live on their own pull requests.

ideas.pitch: A team productivity dashboard that tracks progress on hackathon milestones while running behavioral anomaly detection to flag inactive or sabotaging members.
ideas.title: TaskCrew: Decentralized Task Assignment & Imposter Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical project management utility with the fun Among Us aesthetic, guaranteeing high engagement during live presentations.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage web app utilizing webcam-based rPPG heart rate estimation and multi-language support to rapidly assess emergency patients.
ideas.title: VitalsCrew: Real-Time Biometric Triage & Health Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced browser-based computer vision and clinical triage metrics, mirroring proven hackathon-winning architectures.

ideas.pitch: An interactive dashboard that uses route simulation and emission forecasting to minimize carbon output in multi-node freight logistics.
ideas.title: GreenLogistics AI: Carbon Footprint Optimizer for Supply Chains
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on concrete environmental impact and quantitative optimization, a proven formula for capturing high scores from technical judges.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform that analyzes workout or sports form in real time using pose estimation and confidence-gated scoring.
ideas.title: PoseFix: AI Biomechanical Form & Injury Prevention Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a robust, interactive live demo using webcam tracking that immediately proves technical execution to the judging panel.
